prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent cutout 3D hero decoration for a contemporary event invitation website
Primary request: One compact elegant sculptural knot formed by exactly two interlocked inflated tubular loops, one brushed silver-chrome loop and one glossy dark oxblood burgundy loop.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no backdrop and no ground plane.
Subject: A refined simple two-loop intertwined sculpture floating at a three-quarter angle, with physically believable reflections and a high-end art-directed studio finish. Both loops must be easy to read as separate objects.
Composition/framing: Square composition, centered complete object occupying about 72 percent of frame, generous transparent margin, no cropped edges. Intended display around 300 pixels square on a cool powder blue #dce8f1 web surface.
Lighting/mood: Large soft studio light, realistic highlights, subtle self-shadow, quiet sophisticated contemporary exhibition feeling.
Color palette: brushed polished silver chrome and deep dark oxblood burgundy only.
Materials/textures: softly inflated thick tubes, polished metal with restrained brushing, glossy burgundy lacquer with smooth clean edges.
Text: none.
Constraints: isolated single sculpture, real transparent alpha, crisp antialiased edges, all holes between loops transparent, no cast shadow outside object.
Avoid: abstract tangled mess, rainbow, neon, confetti, letters, logos, watermark, backdrop, ground, border, pedestal, extra objects.
